name: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine

locations.note: 1947: Sophia Hapgood, now with the CIA, finds Indy at his dig in the Canyonlands and tells him the Soviets are excavating Babylon.
In the ruins of the Etemenanki Indy reads the true story of the Tower of Babel; the game returns here for the Infernal Machine and the Aetherium at the end.
The first machine part, in a monastery in the mountains of the Kazakh SSR.
The second part lies inside an active volcano on Palawan.
An Olmec valley in Mexico holds the third part; Indy is captured by the Soviets at the end of it.
Indy wakes as a prisoner on a Soviet ship in the waters of the Canary Islands and breaks out.
The last part waits in a tomb near Meroë, in the desert of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan.
The bonus level returns to the Peruvian temple from the opening of Raiders of the Lost Ark, with another golden idol in a secret room.

routes.name: The four parts of the Infernal Machine
routes.note: From the dig in Utah to Babylon, out to the four machine parts and back to Babylon for the finale; the Peru bonus level is outside the story.
